tagline: Life lessons from people who've lived it. One theme, five voices, 40 seconds.
format: One theme per Short. Eight different elders (70-95), one hard-earned lesson each, 8 s per clip = 64 s, spoken to camera.
style_prompt: Vertical 9:16, hyper-realistic documentary portrait, shot on a 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture with real wrinkles and pores, soft natural light, cinematic colour grade
audio_prompt: No music. No subtitles, no captions, no text on screen.
negative_prompt: text, subtitles, watermarks added by us, logos, celebrities, real identifiable people, uniforms of real organisations

content_rules: Characters are AI-generated; never name them, never claim they are real people or real interviews.
Universal life lessons only. No specific investments, products, medical treatments, legal advice or politics.
Line 1 always states the elder's age and promises the theme. Lines 2-7 are six lessons. Line 8 is the emotional closer.
Each line <= 18 words so Veo can say it naturally in 8 s.
No famous quotes attributed to anyone; write original lines.

Diverse cast described only visually (skin tone, hair, clothes). Never name nationalities or ethnicities, never ask for accents or national dress: TikTok's automated hate-speech filters read AI people performing accents as stereotyping.
ai_disclosure: The people in this video are AI-generated characters (Google Veo). The lessons are real-world wisdom.
